balls.text: Oh, he sure can! MI finish on 215 and that's a huge score in Wankhede's first day game of the season. Knee-high full toss on middle and leg, he gets across and scoops this over short fine leg.
Another low full toss on middle and leg, he works this to deep fine leg
Taken by Pooran at long-on. Low full toss on off stump, the bat turns in his hand as he looks to go over the fielder's head. Pooran takes a simple catch. End of an important cameo, nevertheless.
Carved over extra cover! Low full toss outside off, Bosch backs away, but still manages to reach it and gets four with all fielders inside the ring on the off side
Excellent fielding. Fuller in length outside off, he laces a cover drive by backing away and Marsh fives to his left and saves three

Fuller in length on off, he goes reverse, gets a thick inside-edge onto pad. There is a loud appeal from Avesh, not given. Not sure, what he was appealing for. That came off the middle of the bat onto pad
Flatter angling away from Bosch who slaps this to deep cover. 19 off that over.
Huuuuuge! Right in Bosch's slot outside off, was the wrong'un. He's picked that early as he gets down on one knee and hammers him for an 80m six over deep midwicket
Follows Dhir who was backing away well outside leg stump. Fuller and Dhir pushes to long-on
Going, going, gone! Amazing bat swing. Carrom ball, flicked out of the front of the hand, but Dhir picks it up so well. Full extension of the arms and sends it soaring over long-on
Now the conventional sweep, but he has support in the deep. Fired in down leg, he sweeps and gets it to deep fine leg
Very fine, and four more. Slower through the air outside off, he brings out the reverse and gets an under-edge past the keeper
On a length outside off, he pushes to long-on
Tails the fuller-length ball back into Bosch who gets a thick inside-edge on to his boot as the ball lobs close to the bowler
Length ball outside off, he carves it past point for a couple of runs to get his IPL career going

Oh, he's mistimed that straight to extra cover! What a way to depart. Fullish in length well outside off, he looks to loft this over cover, instead cue-ends it straight to extra cover. Stands there in disbelief.
Fifty for Surya, off just 27 balls! And he gets there in style. Belts a length ball across the line and miles over deep midwicket.
Attempts a wild swing across the line and misses. Fuller in length outside off, was in his arc, but he can't connect
Another inswinging yorker on leg stump, he squeezes this to long-on but that's still a 12-run over
Slower back of a length ball outside off, he cuts this to point, where a slight misfield gets them two
Nails the yorker on middle, he digs this back to the bowler
Another low full toss this time on middle and leg, he presents the full face of the bat and gets this down to long-on
Finds the gap one more time. Shin-high full toss on leg stumps, he works it with authority and more importantly in the gap between deep midwicket and wide long-on
Slower back of a length ball is carved away... for four. Was outside off and he slaps this to the right of deep cover. Badoni hares across, dives but can't keep the ball inside the field of play.
Slower offcutter at 109kph just outside off. Dhir who is standing on off stump works this with soft hands to deep midwicket. Just the second over of the innings without a boundary.
Sharp length ball outside off stump at 136.4kph as Dhir gets across and pushes this to point
Slower length ball on off stump, Surya waits for it before tapping it to long-on for a run
Good length ball at 134.8kph outside off, he shuffles across and pushes towards point for a quick single

Another wide, this time down leg. On a length but the line is awry and Mayank will have to reload. Oh, hang on, LSG have reviewed the wide. Did it flick his thigh before going to Pant? Nope, nothing there. The wide call stands and LSG lose a review.
Slower bouncer outside off, but that was quite high and is called a wide
On a length just outside off, Dhir walks across and defends back to the bowler

Through him! Hardik falls right after the time out. Hard lengths shaping back into Hardik, who is late in bringing down his bat. The ball is through him and takes leg stump. Important strike for the visitors.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, Surya whisks it away to the left of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
Straight as an arrow but long-off is quite straight too. Low full toss on middle, Hardik presents the full face of the blade and unleashes a straight drive.
On a length on middle, he works this towards long-on for a run
Slower short of a length ball but down leg. Called a wide

Oh, that's a Surya special... the Supla shot! Hardik is smiling, he can't believe what he's just seen. It is an on-pace back of a length ball outside off, and what does Surya do. He gets down on one knee, and hooks him over deep fine leg for a 64m six. You need special skills to do that
Banged in short outside off, he pulls this down towards cow corner
Nails the yorker on off stump, think that tailed back in as well a touch. Hardik digs this to point
Hard lengths outside off stump, Hardik mistimes his bosh to mid-off
Angles the length ball on off stump as Hardik bunts this towards mid-off
Low full toss just outside off, he plays a punchy drive to the right of deep cover for a couple of runs to get off the mark
Goes fuller now and on pace around off stump, Surya drives to deep cover
Ramped with precision. And that's 4000 IPL runs for Suryakumar. Slower short of a length ball well outside off. He arches back and ramps him over short third with ease
Good length ball outside off, he taps this to short third

Top-edge, top-edge and Bishnoi has dismissed Tilak for the first time in T20s. Gently tossed up wrong'un well outside the hitting arc of Tilak. Bishnoi slowed it down and got that extra bounce, too. All that added up in inducing a false shot. Tilak reaches for it, sweeps but can only spoon it as far as Prince Yadav at deep midwicket
Slowe through the air again at 99kph on middle, Surya sweeps, but doesn't get a clean enough connection towards deep square leg
Grip, turn and spin and still Surya gets four. Slowed that up, was at 90kph and was the legbreak. The ball spins away, catches the outside edge of Surya's blade and runs away
Flatter well outside off, Surya gets down on one knee and whacks him to the right of deep backward square leg
BAM! That's gone waaaay back into the stands. Darted right in Surya's arc on off. Was the googly and he picked that up so quickly, got underneath it and walloped it over deep midwicket
Almost chops this back on. Wide, very outside off stump and short as well. He steps across and looks to force this through the offside. Can only manage a thick inside-edge past off stump
Slower back of a length ball on leg stump, Tilak gets across and inside the line of that delivery to pull to deep fine leg
On a length angling away from Prince outside off, he defends towards extra cover
What a way to start for Tilak. Low shin-high full toss on middle stump, not the easiest of shots to execute but Tilak stays low and whips this through deep midwicket
Through him! What a delivery from Prince. Aims for the base of middle stump, and gets it on point at 137kph. Jacks is late in bringing his bat down and sees his stumps in a mess

Had to reach really high for it and as a result wasn't in control there Surya. But gets it away from any fielder. Slower short of a length ball outside off. He pulls and the balls lands in between deep midwicket and midwicket
Begins with a yorker right on off stump and Surya can only dig that back to the bowler
Fired in on middle and leg stump at 103kph as Suryakumar shimmies down and whisks to deep midwicket off the inside half of the bat
Darted in on off and middle, Jacks goes back and works to deep midwicket
Flatter outside off, he pushes to long-on

Pant is appealing for a stumping. Will the square leg umpire go upstairs? He doesn't. Flatter trajectory outside off. Surya sweeps and misses. Pant doesn't collect cleanly but the ball bobbles and hits the stump. Surya's foot was grounded though

Just over a leaping Badoni at deep midwicket. Was he too far in? Could he have grabbed that if he was right on the boundary edge? Flatter on off, Surya slogs sweeps and just evades the fielder. Bishnoi is incensed.
Stifle short and wide as Jacks hops back and cuts to deep extra cover
Slower fullish offcutter lands around leg and spins past the flick. Looked wide, not given
Fullish slower ball on leg, clipped to midwicket's left
Deep fine leg's in play... ball sails over him. Fuller side of length on the pads, Jacks helped it along with a whip with the fully closed bat face
Makes room and late cuts a 138ks ball on the move. The shortish ball was following him, rose around rib-height, and Jacks was limboing but managed to get the horizontal bat chopping down onto ball.
Slower length ball on off, worked through square leg. 115ks
Greeted with a lofted off-drive. 135ks full ball around off, SKY not letting the pacer settle. Whacked it with the follow-through stopping midway, he held his shape though
Fullish on off from wide of the crease, flicked to square leg's left for a quick single. Ball hit the inside-half of the bat again
Fullish on middle and leg, 94ks, pushed off the inside-half of the straight bat to midwicket

Deceived in the air and Rathi's grassy notebook is back. Looked like the googly but it's hard to tell with Rathi, who grips the ball with his thumb and forefinger. Was a premeditated shot from Rickelton, made room early and slashed at a slower-looking length ball just outside off. It was a touch too wide, he went through with the shot but top-edged it. Ball lobbed to point. Good innings from Rickelton though
Length on middle and leg, flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket. 97ks
Loopy length ball on leg, 90ks, swept hard to deep square leg. Ball hovered before landing just outside the ring
104ks full ball on middle and leg, Jacks goes for the slog sweep. Plays it late, ball races to short fine leg's left but long leg was fine. So, it'll only be one
Another full toss. Around shin-high and at middle and off; Jacks exposes all three stumps and drives to long-off
Yorker missed. Low full toss on leg released from wide of the crease, the angle in was sharp and Jacks used it to flick the ball between short fine leg and backward square leg

Leading edge on the slog takes the ball to deep third. Mayank almost overran it after moving left but managed to slide back and stop the ball. Was a fullish ball around off that Rickelton wanted to launch over midwicket
Makes room again, gets followed by a shortish ball; pulled along the ground through midwicket

Jacks makes room and goes inside out. Mid-off was in, so he showed all his stumps before the ball was delivered. Avesh tried to follow him with a three-quarter-length ball but Jacks got beside the line and drove it on the rise
Full on fourth, bowled from a 11 o'clock angle, 127ks, whipped to long-on
Cut again, this is straight to deep point
Width offered and the googly is cut hard. Finds the gap between short cover and cover point. Length was slightly short too
Beaten on the swivel-sweep. Rickelton went after it on line as it was slightly down leg but the length ball beat the aggressive bat swing and hit him high on the pad
Cuts the length ball on fifth with the spin, deep point runs left to stop it.
Pitched up on fifth, quick, punched to cover

Pitched up, whipped back low to Bishnoi's right. He half-stops it and the ball rolling to long-on brings up Rickelton's fifty. Fastest so far this season for MI in IPL 2025. He raises his bat and pumps his fists
Shortish ball on the pads, 99ks, flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket. Ends Rathi's most expensive over so far this season

Googly slog swept. This is very much off a length, no length-conversion business, hit on the rise and against the angle too. Ball was angling away through a sixth-stump line but Rickelton got on one knee and pummelled it over midwicket with a free swing

Misfield at cover. Pooran ambled to his right, got low but the ball skidded through. Might've spun away. Was a shortish ball outside off that was cut. Rickelton lunging to reduce the risk on the cross-bat shot
Length on middle, worked to long-on
Wide and full, slashy drive to long-off. 92ks
The slog sweeps keep coming. MI's fifty is up. Turns a length ball into a full one by reaching out and he then heaves it from fourth stump for a flat six over deep midwicket. Speed - 91ks
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Fuller side of length around off, 102ks, defended in front
Essentially swept over the bowler. Got the front foot well forward, close to the pitch of the 91ks full ball just outside off, and whacked it off one knee. Was a googly too
Length on middle, trajectory's very flat, clipped through midwicket

Big lbw appeal from bowler and keeper. Not given, and Bishnoi was asking for the review right away. Pant was confident too, there is a chat and LSG go for it. Impact is the issue here. Jacks was leaning forward but wasn't fully on one knee as he went for the slog sweep. There was a big gap between the ball and the inside edge as he missed it. Hit on the edge of the back thigh. Hawk-Eye shows the shortish ball that landed on fourth stump hit him just outside the line. Review lost
Fullish on fourth, driven to mid-off
Markram charges left from long-off, parries the ball with his left hand but his shirt's in the way as he slides and the ball trickles onto the cushion. Was a full ball that was driven down the ground
Full on off, 97ks - that looked slower though, flicked to long-on
Back of length, lands around sixth and spins away a touch. Beats the slog sweep
Not that short but Rickelton goes for the pull. Cleared the front leg, bent his knee and pulled it to deep midwicket
Fuller side of length on off, 93ks, worked back to the bowler
91ks length ball darting just outside off, looked quicker, worked off the back foot to the bowler's left
Bouncer to start but it's not in the firing line. Fifth-stump line, let go

Mayank has his first wicket of the season with the slower one. A soft dismissal for Rohit, who reached out to the wide length ball and cut straight to short third. His feet were planted, it was just the hands and torso that moved. Couldn't place it in the gap and that ends a promising start
Premeditated crawl outside off doesn't work for Rohit. Mayank might've seen him, went back of length at 136ks, was close to the off-side tramline. Beaten on the pull
Length this time, around top of off. 141ks. Defended towards cover
This is the conventional pull. Weight on the back foot to the 141ks shortish ball that rises around chest height, deep-backward square was in place but the ball clears him easy

Rohit uses the pace to pull it with a check, clears long leg. 141ks on a length, Rohit hopped back and got on one knee before swivelling and getting the bat lift from down to up. Played from well in front of the body
Short ball down leg, goes past the pull. Went around shoulder height. Pace not shown
Almost dragged back onto the stumps. Rickelton swivels for the pull, the shortish ball hits him on the ribs and deflects onto glove, the ball then lobbed back. Ended up rolling through fourth stump
Pulled over mid-on. Off a length, fifth-stump line. Hit off the bottom of the bat but cleared the fielder who leapt high.
Rickelton's drive decks Rohit at the non-striker's. A fierce drive to a full toss speared around Rohit's chest, he covered his face and fell on his back in time
Clips the length ball from off stump to midwicket. 136ks
Slogged off a length. Rather graceful too. Was a channel ball but the batter picked it up on the rise and deposited it over cow corner

No direct hit from point and Rickelton gets away after having given up. Makram was the fielder with one stump to aim at, threw it centimetres away from the stumps as Rickelton jogged back. Was a length ball outside off that was square driven off the back foot. Rickelton took off, Rohit responded by running before sending his partner back
Length on fourth, 138ks, punched off the back foot to mid-off's left
Overpitched and it's crunched straight mid-off. More of a smothered flick than a drive but Rickelton didn't close the bat face, which took the ball straight
Proper short ball but spongy bounce thereafter. Might be a sign of the pitch being slow. 136ks, over the batter's head. Ducked under by Rickelton
Beaten on the pull. Back of length, 141ks, sharp angle away. Landed around fourth and finished around sixth, Rickelton tried to drag it leg side with the pull
Rickelton leans into the cover drive. Hits the fullish 142ks ball angling away through sixth to cover. Nicely timed
Same speed, back of length. Fourth-stump channel, ball bounces around waist-height and is bunted towards mid-off
Good ball to start. 141ks fullish on fourth, swinging in a touch, punched with a straight bat to the bowler's right

A sensational way to end the innings and this is MI's fifth straight win this year. This is also the 150th victory for MI in the IPL, the first time for any team in the league. And it's fitting Boult gets that final wicket. Angles the on-pace length ball on middle and leg. Rathi misses and his stumps are rattled.
On a length on middle and leg, he ticks this to the on-side
Slower short of a length ball around his ribs on leg stump. He defends
Low full toss angling across the batter who throws his hands at it and gets it down to deep point
Back of a length ball on off, he stays leg side of the ball and pushes to point for a run
Yorker on middle stump, he somehow digs it out
Hard length on off stump, he gets a thick inside-edge onto pad. Bosch ends his spell with 1 for 26
A high full toss well down leg, Rickelton does so well to dive to his left and save a few extra runs

A maiden IPL wicket for Bosch and isn't he delighted!  A 133.8kph yorker heading for middle stump. Bishnoi looks to go across the line, is nowhere near it and sees his stumps in a mess. Bosch is ecstatic, the crowd is ecstatic and MI are on the verge of a fifth straight win
Slower short of a length ball on middle, Bishnoi is way too early into his pull and misses
Another pinpoint yorker on off stump, Bishnoi somehow gets his bat down in time and digs this out
Yorker angling across the batter on off, he digs this out
Fuller in length and well down leg. Called a wide

Swish and a miss! Hang on, MI have reviewed for a caught behind. On a length on leg stump. Prince gives himself room and looks to tonk this away. Was there any bat there? Nope, the ball hits Prince's pad through to the keeper. MI are out of reviews.

Well, hello! Is that the shot of Bishnoi's career? And isn't he pleased! Gets a length ball on off stump, Bishnoi gets in position and thumps Bumrah over long-on. There is a fist pump, and another as the camera pans to the LSG dugout. A few smiles there as well. Pant looks on perplexed
Banged in short at pace on middle stump at 130kph, Bishnoi ducks under
Nails the yorker again on off and middle, squeezed to covers
And now the sharp bouncer aiming for Prince's ribs. He his hit on the glove as he looks to fend this away. Wrings his hand in pain
Shin-high full toss on off, he pushes to cover
That's well watched by Prince Yadav. Bumrah went the slow yorker way at 111kph on middle and leg stump. Prince made sure to bring the full face of the bat in front and defend
On a good length on off stump, Bishnoi punches to extra cover
Another back of a length ball on off, Bishnoi was looking to bosh it away again, and misses, again
There is an appeal for caught behind, not given and this time MI have reviewed. Back of a length ball on middle, he looks for a swish across the line. Connects at thin air. MI lose a review.
Bangs this halfway down and beats Bishnoi. On middle and leg, he was looking to ramp this fine, misses.
BANG! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, he gets across and pulls this with authority over deep backward square leg
length ball outside off, he laces the drive but straight to mid-off

An upward shift of 20kph on that previous ball. It's a yorker one more time and this time the ball hits off pole. Oh, man, what a bowler! Yorker on the base of off stump, there is nothing Avesh could do.

The slow dipping yorker of Bumrah does Samad all in! Such a special delivery from a special bowler. Slower offcutter at 122kph on middle, Samad is through the shot waaay too early and sees his middle stump pushed back. Bumrah wheels away in celebration.
Low full toss at pace on off stump, he works this to the right of long-on for a run
Nails the yorker on off stump, he squeezes this to point

Bumrah comes back and removes Miller. Is that the end for LSG? Miller backs away but Bumrah follows him. It is a shin-high full toss that Miller flicks. He gets it on the higher part of the blade and the ball spoons straight up. Bosch goes reverse-cup and takes it comfortably at deep midwicket
Fuller in length on off stump, he whisks it to deep midwicket
Low full toss on Miller's pad, he works this to the left of deep midwicket for a couple of runs.
Another solid yorker from Boult. On leg stump, Samad misses the flick and wears it on the pad
Full on middle and leg stump, Miller backs away and pushes to long-on
Fuller in length on middle stump, he works this to long-on

Another one bites the dust! Slower short of a length ball on off. Badoni backs away and looks to carve this over point/short third. The lack of pace however does not allow him any power behind the shot and taps this straight to point
Nails the yorker on leg stump, Miller digs this to long-on

Is that a wide? Nope. Badoni was looking for it, the umpire's hands stay down. Length ball down leg, Badoni looks for a  scoop and misses. Wait, wait! He didn't miss it. Replays suggest there was a thin edge through to the keeper but no one appealed
Tonked back and Bosch gets a finger on it. That's about it. Was a good length ball outside off, he clobbers this back over the bowler's head who parries to long-off
Reload! Wayward length ball well down leg. Rickelton does well with a sprawling dive to his right
Miller cashes in! Shin-high full toss well outside off. Miller stays still and thumps him straight over the non-striker's head
A third low full toss on the bounce well outside off. Miller bunts this over extra cover for two more.
Another low full toss on leg stump, he works this to the right of deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Low full toss on middle and leg stump, he whisks this to wide long-on

Hard hit, straight hit, four runs! Miller backs away and Jacks follows him, but Miller is upto the task. He goes through the shot and more importantly targets the straight boundary over the bowler's head
Yorker on leg stump, Miller squeezes this back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, he drives this uppishly over covers for a couple of runs
Big turn for Jacks. Floated on off, turning away from Miller's outside edge.
Oh, dear, Surya has a mess of that! Tossed up on off stump, he backs away and mistimes his chip to Surya. He initially goes for the catch, then stops and eventually can't prevent the boundary
Flatter good length ball on off stump, he miscues his pull to long-on
Slower offcutter at 116kph angling across Badoni, who cuts this to deep point. Just three of the over.
Good length ball outside off stump, he cuts this to Bumrah at deep third for a run
On a length on off and middle, he pushes towards covers
On-pace length ball just outside off, Miller prods forward and punches to mid-off

Straight up and Marsh's sprightly knock has come to an end. That's such an important wicket. Slower short of a length ball at 116.6kph angling across Marsh. That meant the batter had to reach for it and couldn't control his pull. Gets a top edge that spoons straight up and dep square leg rushes it to take a comfortable catch
Slower short of a good length ball angling across Badoni, who cuts this to deep point for a run
Six from Bosch's first over. Was a yorker on leg stump, which Badoni flicked to deep midwicket
A very important boundary from Badoni. Was a fuller-length ball on off stump. Badoni jumps right across and scoops this to the fine leg fence
Another dot ball. Badoni backs away but Bosch follows him outside leg stump, cramping him for room. Badoni can only carve this to backward point
Knee-high full toss at 142.4kph on off, he drives but straight to extra cover for a run
Fullish on leg stump, Marsh pushes towards long-on for a run
Fullish in length on middle and leg, he squeezes it to short fine leg
Inside out again, not middled but falls safely in the outfield. Was a length ball just outside off to which a premeditated shot was played
Badoni made room again, so Karn went wide outside off this time. Slow legbreak on a length spun close to thetramline, Badoni ran back and cut it. Bottom hand came off but the ball raced through point
Marsh misses out. The fullish ball was darted down leg, swept hard but deep fine leg is fine. Marsh finds him
Full at the stumps, worked to long-on
Over extra this time. Made room early again, got on one knee and drove high. Ball was on the fuller side of length around middle, was spinning away, so it was hit with the turn
Makes room and thumps it over the bowler. Karn tried following him with a 91ks legbreak, it landed too full. Badoni got on one knee and essentially swept it. 85 metres far
Marsh walks towards the wide bouncer before letting it go. It was well outside the tramline but the ump doesn't call it wide. No review from LSG
Length on fourth, sharp angle in. 122ks. Caresses a square drive off the back foot to deep point
Wide yorker with pace on, drilled to deep cover. 132ks
Goes again, misses. The fullish ball was just inside the tramline. Slower again, no deviation on this offcutter. Marsh slashed hard, wanted to go through point but the ball bounced above his swing
Through point this time. Pandya goes length for this slower ball, Marsh waits for the ball to just pass him before cutting hard. It went behind point in fact
Half-tracker is pulled from wide outside off. Offcutter spun in a touch, rose around thigh-high and Marsh had a lot of time to whack it wide of mid-on
Fullish on middle, Badoni slides his back leg leg side to drive to cover
Wide and short, 91ks, gets turn away again. Would've been wide had Marsh left it. He reaches out and slaps it hard, finds long-off
Dances down again. Gets followed and yorked, driven to wide long-off
Dances down and gets it on the low full toss. The 88ks ball is well outside off and is driven through cover. Along the ground, good stop in the deep
Fullish on leg, 91ks, beats the flick and deflects off the pad to short third
Fullish length ball on middle turns away a touch, punched off the back foot to point
Fine leg is back and Jacks continues to fire it in at leg stump. 88ks but it looked quicker. Badoni is across to off stump, got on one knee and paddled it through leg slip
Shortish on leg, skiddy again, pulled into the ground. Goes to deep-backward square. 97ks
Fullish at the stumps, flicked through midwicket

Pant's horror run continues, he's lobbed a reverse sweep to short third. Jacks bags another leftie. Was a loopy offbreak on a fullish length, landed around leg. Pant premeditated, went across, might've gotten too far inside the line and got the edge. Karn, the catcher, runs rampant as do MI. Pant smiles in resignation with Zaheer after getting into the dugout
Quicker fullish length ball on fifth, skiddy and flat, Pant edges a cut through where first slip would've been

Strikes first ball!. The field spread after the powerplay and SKY is pumped after taking a running catch from long-off. He went left, lunged and fell forward in follow-through with ball in hand. Was a hit-me ball though. Looped into the slot from around the wicket, was driven through the line.
Full on off, worked to long-on. 137ks
Change of plan from Chahar and Pooran's ready for it. Into the pitch just outside off, Pooran stands tall and pulls it hard over midwicket. Big six

To the other side this time. This looked like a half-chance at first, Boult was a few metres in from the deep-backward point ropes. Might've had his weight to the left but then realised he had to change direction. He reached out his with his right hand but the ball sailed. Was another wide yorker that was square driven aerially. The bat face was fully open and then twisted up further on impact
Scythed over point for six. Pooran's first one in a while. There was deep-backward point but the ball sailed to his left. Was a wide yorker at 135ks, landed just outside the crease.
Wide full toss lands outside the cut strip but well past the pitch. That's why it's just wide and not a no-ball. Let go of course
Yorker on off, slapped to mid-off. Pooran not able to get under it but powered it along the ground
And Pooran tries to line him up, gets beaten trying to slog sweep him into oblivion. Length ball through fourth stump was awfully close to knocking Pooran over
Another missed yorker. Full toss just above the boot angles in from around the wicket, punched through mid-on
Yorker on off, jammed into the pitch with the defensive straight bat. Gets it past the bowler
High-ish full toss, dips late so Bumrah gets away with the no-ball. 134ks again but that too looked slow. Came around thigh-high and Pooran crouched while pulling it to deep square leg
Goes for the yorker, length's okay but it's down leg. Past the flick, to the keeper.
Another slower one. No, 134ks, but that looked slow. Wide on a length, Marsh tried to caress it to deep point, bottom edged it into ground and the ball rolled through square leg
Back to the offcutter. Back of length, lands around fifth and angles in. Bounces much lesser than Marsh expected, goes under the bat. Marsh smiles at Bumrah
Slugged high and mighty! Second-tier hit over midwicket. 95 metres! Ball was a touch fuller than length, angling in towards off, Marsh stood stall and took a swipe across the line
Dhir runs to his left from deep square leg and dives forward... gets half-volleyed. The ball grazes his palms and shoots up over him. Was a shortish ball that was pulled flat in the air
Low fully outside off, pushed to cover
Appeal for a strangle down leg. Wide given; no, actually. Bowler excited, Rickelton isn't convinced. No review. Shortish 124ks ball down leg went past the attempted pull
Looked slow. Fullish length ball on off, defended into the pitch. 121ks
Low fully, might've swung away a touch, punched with a straight bat down the ground

Full toss is clattered straight of mid-off. Around shin-high, fourth-stump line; Marsh took a small stride towards the line and took a big swipe. Bat swipe went from fine-leg through mid-off and finished with a flurry
Full and slow on the pads, flicked through square leg
Length on off, defended towards cover

Flicked straight to deep-backward square leg. Not a bowler's wicket as such but Bumrah will take that. 141ks length ball on the pads followed Markram as he gave away the stumps. He didn't transfer weight but timed it nicely, whipped it flat and the placement did him in. Naman was the only fielder deep fielder on the leg side
Might've been slow, yep 123ks. Length ball on off, gets decent bounce - rises top-of-stump height. Markram stands beside the ball and defends with the straight bat
Hit around the box. Markram was backing away but the 134ks length ball kept following him, beat him on the flick.
Touch back of length, sharp angle in. Beats the flick and hits just over the pad
Fullish ball is driven to mid-off for a quick single. Markram slips after completing the run, the spikes seemed to have gotten stuck in the grass
Slower length ball rises well over middle, Markram was leg side of the ball and fended with a slightly open-faced bat. Ball goes off the edge to short third
Three-quarter length on middle, 120ks, might've straightened off the pitch. Defended in front
Similar. This is a touch fuller on the same line and Marsh jams the ball onto the ground and it bounces high over the bowler
Gets away with the free hit. Chahar goes for the wide yorker, not nailed but Marsh didn't move across. So, he was reaching out and could only toe an attempted drive to cover
Low fully at 136ks. It's on off stump, Marsh leans forward and pushes it to mid-on. Klaxon goes off, big no-ball from Chahar. No part of the foot on the line
Wow, that's hit the ring on the roof! Marsh whipped the fullish ball on the pad high over square leg. Help-along-the-way stuff
Length on off, defended to the bowler
Cut in the same area. Length ball just inside the tramline but that's effectively short and wide, Markram reaches out and belts it along the ground
Slower one... no, speedometer says 135ks. Was wide and full, Markram got on one knee and reached out for a flowing horizontal-bat square drive in front of point
138ks fullish ball on fourth, slapped to mid-off
Steps out to get to the pitch of the 135ks ball and chips a flick to deep square leg
Beaten on the flick, hits flush on the front pad but the three-quarter-length ball was going down leg. Very sharp angle
